name: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Limited
summary: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Limited manufactures industrial and medical gases in India. It offers industrial gases, such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, helium, acetylene, hydrogen, nitrous oxide, synthetic air, and special gases; and medical gases, including medical oxygen, medical nitrogen, medical nitrous oxide, and medical grade carbon dioxide.
